scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build:ui && pnpm pack:check && pnpm build:docs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/publish.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bolerish/tokens typecheck && pnpm --filter @bolerish/registry build && pnpm --filter @bolerish/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @bolerish/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @bolerish/docs typecheck
